reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape for a compliant finding.

The rule protects the Customer by limiting Vendor audit rights; the cited paragraphs (Section 3 use restrictions, Section 17(b) self-certification of destruction/return) contain no Garman audit, inspection, entry or system-access right, so the absence of any such right is more favourable than the preferred position and correctly logged as compliant rather than missing.

The Section 17(b) certification is a Customer self-certification with no Vendor entry or system access, so it does not engage the rule's frequency/notice/cost/access parameters, as the rationale states.

The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is a false signal here: the regex has no audit clause to match, and inserting audit parameters would manufacture a Vendor entitlement and worsen our position, so proposing no edit is the correct minimal action.
